text: The Patriots' roster continues to absorb casualties from their Week 2 victory over Pittsburgh, with starting right guard Mike Onwenu sidelined by a broken right ankle that will require time to heal, while safety Dell Pettus has been placed on injured reserve. To shore up the linebacker position, New England signed Jose Ramirez to the 53-man roster from the practice squad and added Benton Whitley to the practice squad, signaling the team's need for depth at the position heading into Sunday's Week 3 matchup against Jacksonville at Everbank Stadium. Though the defense carried the load in that 20-3 triumph over Aaron Rodgers and Pittsburgh—with TreVeyon Henderson contributing a rushing touchdown—the offense continues to search for the rhythmic efficiency that characterized last season's Super Bowl run, a challenge that QB Drake Maye will need to address against the Jaguars on Sunday at 1 PM ET.
